info.title: broiler-review — the command-line half of the Broiler Code Human Review workspace.
info.description: Broiler development tools: human code-review coverage, stale-review checks, and C# code-assurance annotations and reports.

commands.name: assurance
commands.description: Per-declaration assurance annotations of one component

commands.name: check
commands.description: --root <dir> [--config <file>] [--release] [--sources-only] [--json <out>|-]

options.name: --root
options.description: Repository root. Defaults to the working directory.

options.name: --extensions
options.description: Comma-separated source extensions. Defaults to ".cs".

options.name: --markdown
options.description: Write the coverage report as Markdown.

options.name: --json
options.description: Write the coverage report as JSON.

options.name: --minimum
options.description: Fail when coverage is below this. Off by default.

options.name: --changed
options.description: A file of changed paths, one per line, to restrict "check" to.

options.name: --fail-on-stale
options.description: Make "check" exit non-zero. Annotates only by default.

options.name: --status
options.description:
Restrict "list" to states whose label contains this.
Review records live in .broiler-review/ beside the source and are meant to be
committed. Staleness is decided by content, not by commit: a rebase does not
invalidate a review, and a revert restores one.
